meta.purpose: Static override table for geoBoundaries CGAZ ADM1 → user-facing city display name. Applied AFTER a GPS point is matched to an ADM1 feature. If (iso, adm_name, bbox intersect trigger_bbox) matches an override row, the user-facing displayed name becomes override_name (and, for polygon-swap overrides, the polygon used for containment/rendering is swapped to the override polygon).

data_source_convention.policy_A_adm1_ok: ADM1 shapeName is acceptable — no override, but shapeName may need Latin transliteration (e.g. 'Shanghaishi' → 'Shanghai'). Handled by a separate cleanup pass, NOT this table.
data_source_convention.policy_B_swap_to_adm2: ADM1 covers area much larger than the well-known city. Swap the ADM1 polygon for a specific geoBoundaries ADM2 polygon when the GPS falls inside a small trigger bbox around the city core.
data_source_convention.policy_C_rename_only: Keep the ADM1 polygon, but rename the display label (e.g. 'Île-de-France' → 'Paris (Île-de-France)') because ADM2 alternative is too small (Paris commune 105 km²) and users still expect 'Paris' for anywhere in the metro.
data_source_convention.policy_D_unmapped: geoBoundaries has no clean ADM boundary that matches user expectation (e.g. NYC = union of 5 counties; Sydney metro = 35 LGAs). Listed in unmapped_cases; would require custom polygon in a follow-up dataset.

meta.trigger_bbox_format: [west_lng, south_lat, east_lng, north_lat] in WGS84 degrees. Rough bboxes only — precise verification against actual ADM1 geometry required before shipping.
verification_required_before_ship: 1. Confirm each geobounds_shape_name string matches the actual shapeName field in geoBoundaries v6 CGAZ ADM1 (case, diacritics, spaces).
2. For policy_B rows: confirm the ADM2 shapeName exists in geoBoundaries v6 CGAZ ADM2 (some countries have no ADM2 in CGAZ, e.g. small states).
3. Test each trigger_bbox with a sample GPS point known to be in that city.

unmapped_cases.problem: USA has no ADM level between state (ADM1) and county (ADM2). NYC = union of 5 counties: New York (Manhattan), Kings (Brooklyn), Queens, Bronx, Richmond (Staten Island). No single 'NYC' polygon exists in geoBoundaries.
workaround_options: A. Accept ADM1='New York' (State) label — 141k km², wrong for NYC users but 'not entirely wrong'.

B. BUILD custom polygon: geoBoundaries ADM2 UNION of the 5 NYC counties (Bronx, Kings, New York, Queens, Richmond). Load as override polygon with shapeName='New York City'. Trigger bbox: [-74.26, 40.49, -73.70, 40.92].
C. Buy/source Nominatim or OSM place polygon for 'New York City' relation.
unmapped_cases.recommendation: B — union 5 counties from geoBoundaries ADM2. This is a one-off custom polygon in the seed pipeline, feasible without licensing issues.

unmapped_cases.problem: LA metro spans multiple counties. Even 'City of Los Angeles' proper is not an ADM level in geoBoundaries (US ADM2 = county). Los Angeles County exists but is 10,570 km² and only ~40% of metro.
workaround_options: B. Use geoBoundaries ADM2 shapeName='Los Angeles' (county) — better but still not 'City of LA'.
C. Custom polygon 'City of Los Angeles' from OSM.
unmapped_cases.recommendation: B for v428, C for later.

unmapped_cases.problem: Chicago city is not ADM2. Cook County (ADM2) is close but larger.
workaround_options: B. ADM2='Cook' county — approximately fine for Chicago users (5M in Cook County vs 2.7M in city).

unmapped_cases.problem: SF is a consolidated city-county — coextensive with San Francisco County (ADM2). Actually a CLEAN case if ADM2 available.
workaround_options: B. geoBoundaries USA ADM2 shapeName='San Francisco' (county)

unmapped_cases.problem: Sydney metro = 35 LGAs across parts of NSW. No 'Greater Sydney' LGA. City of Sydney LGA is only 27 km² (CBD only).
workaround_options: A. Accept ADM1='New South Wales' — very wrong for Sydney users.
B. Use ABS 'Greater Capital City Statistical Area' (GCCSA) — GCCSA_2016 for 'Greater Sydney' exists but is a statistical geography, not geoBoundaries.
C. Union of 35 LGAs from geoBoundaries CAN ADM2.
D. Rename ADM1='New South Wales' → 'Greater Sydney' when GPS in Sydney bbox, keep polygon (imprecise but avoids wrong label).
unmapped_cases.recommendation: D for v428 (rename-only, quick), C for v429+ (proper polygon).
